ideas.title: Following the Money in Childcare Scams
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial trail behind recent childcare scams, including the $2.76M scholarship scam in Baltimore.
questions: How did the scammers launder the money?
What banks and financial institutions were involved?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale financial scheme and highlight the need for increased oversight in the childcare industry.

ideas.title: Uncovering the Truth Behind ICE Shootings
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent ICE shootings, including the case in Minnesota where the state is suing the federal government for evidence.
questions: What really happened in these shootings?
Is there a pattern of negligence or corruption in ICE operations?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a pattern of negligence or corruption in ICE operations and highlight the need for increased transparency and accountability.
